newsitems.title: The Last of the Druids Sale - Get One Free Mystery Box When You Spend Points
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents:
This weekend, we’re running a sale on microtransactions from past Mystery Boxes, including the Last of the Druids cosmetic effects. In addition, we’re offering one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box when you spend points in the store.

[h3]Weekend Sale[/h3]
From the time of this news post until Sep 28, 2026 4:00 PM PST, all cosmetic effects from the Sentinel, Kalandra, Sanctum, Crucible, Ancestor, Affliction, Necropolis, Settlers, Dawn of the Hunt, Third Edict and Last of the Druids Mystery Boxes, as well as their variations, are going on sale, so you can grab them at a discounted price!

Check out the contents of the Last of the Druids Mystery Box below.

[previewyoutube=EM5FqUDBHjo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Get a free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box When You Spend Points[/h3]
For the duration of the weekend sale, we’re offering one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box when you spend any amount of points in the store. This means you can purchase anything discounted in the sale or any other microtransaction from the store and receive one Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box as a gift from us. 

[b]Please note:[/b] It’s only possible to get one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box from this promotion. Making additional microtransaction purchases will not grant additional Mystery Boxes. Purchasing a supporter pack will not grant a free Mystery Box but spending points from a supporter pack can grant a free Mystery Box.

Players who have unlocked all microtransactions from the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box will receive two Warlord Mystery Boxes instead.

Thank you for your support!

newsitems.title: Fan Art Competition Winners

Our Fan Art Competition concluded last week, with more than 150 Exiles submitting artwork inspired by the latest Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2 content expansions. With the help of our art team, we’ve selected the winners and are now ready to announce them!

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 1 ExileCon Qualifiers Begin Next Week
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents:
It’s finally happening! The ExileCon Path of Exile 1 Qualifiers kick off next week, with the top racers from all four qualifier events earning the chance to compete in the live final at ExileCon in New Zealand.

The competition will take place on the following dates, with ZiggyD and Raiz once again serving as your hosts throughout the event:

[b]Path of Exile 1 Qualifier Event Times and Dates[/b]
[list]
[*] Qualifier One - September 4 2PM PDT
[*] Qualifier Two - September 11 2PM PDT
[*] Qualifier Three - September 18 2PM PDT
[*] Qualifier Four - September 25 2PM PDT[/list]
If you're participating in the event, please make sure that your Path of Exile account is linked to your Twitch account. You can do this by logging into your account on the website, then clicking here.

To join a qualifier event, click the "Join" button for the race on the Character Select screen. You'll then be prompted to create a character. Once you've entered the game, your character will remain stationary until the race officially begins.

Players will compete to be the first to kill Kitava in Act 5 in a Standard Solo Self-Found fixed-seed environment. While this is not a Hardcore event, players will incur a penalty upon death and will be unable to move until one minute has elapsed.

The qualifier events are PC only.

You can find the full ruleset [url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3985393]here[/url].

Be sure to join us at [url=twitch.tv/pathofexile]twitch.tv/pathofexile[/url] to check out all the action! New Twitch Drops will be available for viewers, and we’ll announce them next week.

Good luck, Exiles!

newsitems.title: Fan Art Competition
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents:
It’s been a while since we last hosted a fan art competition, and with the recent updates to Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2, we’re sure our community artists have plenty of inspiration to draw from. We’re excited to announce a Path of Exile Fan Art Competition inspired by the Return of the Ancients and Curse of the Allflame expansions! The prize pool includes official merchandise and in-game microtransactions.
[h3]Prizes[/h3]
[b]Top Three Winners[/b]
[list]
[*] Forum avatar based on the winning submission
[*] Your choice of Path of Exile poster signed by developers
[*] Your choice of two Path of Exile or Path of Exile 2 T-shirts
[*] 2 x random Path of Exile Pin
[*] Chaos Orb Socks
[*] Chaos Orb Deskpad
[*] Exalted Orb Cap
[*] Your choice of an Armour Set (an Armour Set from the list)
[*] Your choice of a Portal Effect (a Portal Effect from the list)
[*] Your choice of Footprints Effect (a Footprints Effect from the list)
[/list]
[b]4-5th Place[/b]
[list]
[*] Your choice of one Path of Exile or Path of Exile 2 T-shirt
[*] Chaos Orb Socks
[*] 2 x random Path of Exile Pin
[*] Chaos Orb Deskpad
[*] Your choice of an Armour Set (an Armour Set from the list)
[*] Your choice of a Portal Effect (a Portal Effect from the list)
[*] Your choice of Footprints Effect (a Footprints Effect from the list)
[/list]
[b]6-10th Place[/b]
[list]
[*] Your choice of one Path of Exile or Path of Exile 2 T-shirt
[*] Chaos Orb Socks
[*] A random Path of Exile Pin
[*] Your choice of a Portal Effect (a Portal Effect from the list)
[*] Your choice of Footprints Effect (a Footprints Effect from the list)
[/list]
[b]11-20th Place[/b]
[list]
[*] Your choice of a Portal Effect (a Portal Effect from the list)
[/list]
[b]Runners-Up[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 x Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box
[/list]
[h3]Conditions[/h3]
[list]
[*] The competition starts at the time of this post and will end on Wednesday the 2nd of September at 10PM PDT. Submissions made after this time will not be counted. We'll post the winners sometime in the following days.
[*] Any work that is submitted must be your own and must be created after the launch of this competition.
[*] AI generated art will not be accepted. We reserve the right to disqualify your entry if we believe that it is AI generated.
[*] Multiple submissions are welcome.
[*] We may increase the prize pool if we receive an overwhelming number of high-quality submissions.
[/list]
[h3]How to Enter[/h3]
Create still art that is inspired by anything introduced in the Return of the Ancients (Path of Exile 2) or Curse of the Allflame (Path of Exile 1). This excludes video submissions but does include any painting, drawing or model creation. 

Multiple submissions are welcome and encouraged. Your submission needs to be your own work and needs to have been created after the launch of the competition. [b]Please do not submit artwork that was created before the start of the competition.[/b]

Best of luck! We can’t wait to see your creations!

[url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3995722][h1]Submit your art here[/h1][/url]
